decisions.reason: After two years, this low-visibility fifteen-day express offer appears redundant beside the broader express portfolio, so its remaining option value no longer outweighs the operational complexity it consumes.

The certified fire-resistant steel exterior door is tightly linked to the firm's modular safety range and core compliance strengths, making withdrawal unlikely after another year of market validation.

With the seventy-two-hour offer already exited, this broader express line remains the firm's scalable fast-delivery option and is worth retaining while demand and process efficiencies continue to develop.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the strategic shift toward deeper service and complex-project support, and its learning and integration benefits are high relative to the cost of keeping it live.
This fire and smoke protection door fits the firm's safety-led portfolio and shares capabilities with adjacent products, so it remains a reasonable option to keep as demand evidence matures.
